gateway_head: 1) the a-c-t-o-r o-b-s-e-r-v-e-d the f-a-c-i-a-l s-c-a-n n-o-d-e-s and l-e-f-t a s-e-r-v-e-r d-u-m-p s-h-o-w-i-n-g c-a-c
text:
1) the a-c-t-o-r o-b-s-e-r-v-e-d the f-a-c-i-a-l s-c-a-n n-o-d-e-s and l-e-f-t a s-e-r-v-e-r d-u-m-p s-h-o-w-i-n-g c-a-c-h-e d-a-t-a, s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-u-d-i-t l-o-g r-e-t-e-n-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k
2) the a-c-t-o-r i-n-s-e-r-t-e-d a d-e-c-o-y t-o-k-e-n into the f-i-n-g-e-r p-r-i-n-t s-c-a-n-n-e-r and l-e-f-t a h-a-r-d-w-a-r-e s-e-q-u-e-n-c-e f-i-l-e, s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the d-e-v-i-c-e i-n-t-e-g-r-i-t-y s-c-a-n
3) the a-c-t-o-r b-a-c-k-d-o-o-r-e-d the r-e-g-i-s-t-e-r-y and l-e-f-t a r-o-w l-o-g s-e-q-u-e-n-c-e, s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the r-o-w c-h-a-n-g-e a-u-d-i-t
4) the a-c-t-o-r a-d-d-e-d a r-o-w to the a-c-c-e-s-s l-o-g f-o-r a v-a-l-i-d e-m-p-l-o-y-e-e and l-e-f-t a s-h-a-d-o-w t-i-m-e-s-t-a-m-p, s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the r-o-w t-i-m-e-s-t-a-m-p v-a-l-i-d-a-t-i-o-n
5) the a-c-t-o-r m-o-d-i-f-i-e-d the l-o-g f-i-l-t-e-r c-o-n-f-i-g and l-e-f-t a c-o-n-f-i-g d-i-f-f f-i-l-e, s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the l-o-g i-n-t-e-g-r-i-t-y c-h-e-c-k
